title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Scripture never says loco-sin; Christ truly satisfied / died / suffered in our place
pass_a_gloss: Scripture never says loco-sin for Adam, and the claim is absurd. Christ truly did what loco means—satisfy, die, suffer for us who were bound to those things.
pass_b_english: For Scripture nowhere says that, and it is exceedingly absurd. Christ did indeed satisfy divine justice in our place—for we were bound to satisfy. All of us had to die; he tasted death in our place. All of us were to be punished; he suffered in the place of all.
source_text: Nam neque id Scriptura dicit uspiam, & valde absurdum est. Satisfecit quidem loco nostro Christus iustitiae divinae: quippe nos enim tenebamur satisfacere. Moriendum erat omnibus nobis, ipse mortem loco nostro gustavit. Puniendi eramus omnes, ipse omnium loco passus est.

lemmas.gloss: suffered in the place of all
